timecoded_text_to_speech.text: Here I have a mass on a spring.
If I give it a tug, it vibrates for a while until slowly coming to a stop.
It comes to a stop because of the dampening in the system.
If I increase the dampening, as I can do by adjusting this magnet here, the oscillation
comes to a stop much more quickly.
